dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are young people so rare here?

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: They all left for Liyue Harbor. Young people always prefer somewhere a bit more exciting.

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: I used to run a blacksmith's there — Hanfeng's Ironmongers. My apprentices would all have been around your age.

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: Personally, I don't like Liyue Harbor, though. All that hustle and bustle... I'm too old to work with iron now, so I thought I might as well head back to the countryside and help out where I can, while I still have strength in me.
